description: Get the task in progress (in this project when you pass project), with its steps and the next one to do. Call this at the start of a session. Returns the most recently active in-progress task, its numbered steps with ids (with descriptions and the summaries of done steps), the next step's id and the latest 3 notes (taskhold_get shows 10); with nothing in progress (or an unknown project) it says so and names taskhold_begin and taskhold_list.

project.description: Project name, e.g. the repo folder ("api-server"). Matched case-insensitively (or a project id). An unknown name matches nothing.

name: taskhold_get_current
title: Get current tasks
